name: ahau-v2
description: Backend-agnostic data-access contract for Āhau v2

scripts.test: npm run check:manifest && npm run build && node --test dist && node scripts/check-contract-coverage.mjs --ci && node scripts/check-conformance-coverage.mjs --ci
scripts.build:happ: hc dna pack dnas/ahau/workdir && hc app pack workdir
scripts.test:conductor: npm run build:happ && npm run build && node --test $(find dist -name '*.conductor.js')
scripts.conductor: npm run build:happ && hc sandbox clean && echo pass | hc sandbox --piped generate workdir/ahau.happ --app-id ahau --run=8888 network mem
